title: Kelton's Dark Corner 4: The Kelton Marathon
original_title: Kelton's Dark Corner 4: The Kelton Marathon
overview: "Life's tough in the big city." But life just got a whole lot tougher for Kelton the cop. Kelton the Cop as a young man was forced to face his fears, constantly being called upon to go one-on-one with supernatural entities such as "spooks, ghouls and zombies" with little more than a gun and a badge.
